title: From Finite-Node Conifold Geometry to BPS Structures III: Mediated Triangle Transport and Graded Interaction Data
summary: In previous work, we extracted from a finite-node conifold degeneration the state-data package $A_Σ=(V_Σ,E_Σ,c_Σ)$ and then constructed the support-level interaction package encoded by a binary incidence structure and finite quiver-theoretic skeleton \cite{RahmanQuiverDataI,RahmanQuiverDataII}. The present paper introduces the next layer: a graded pairwise interaction package refining binary support. Since the support matrix records where a mediated channel is present, but not its derived size, cohomological degree, or exact-triangle behavior, we introduce \emph{mediated triangle transport}…
